meta.method: cells with prospectivity_rank >= 95.0 clustered with 8-connectivity on the 0.01 degree lattice; components > 50 cells split by k-means on coordinates; clusters with < 4 cells dropped; top 40 by mean rank kept
meta.geology_support_basis: All MRDS Mn training records in the study area fall on Precambrian units of the geology lattice (vs ~62% of the area).
meta.subsurface_note: No legitimate drilling, assay or geophysical data are available to this project; subsurface_status is UNAVAILABLE for every target. data/subsurface_evidence.csv defines the schema.
